status: audit complete; candidate fails bounded accessibility gate

confirmedFindings.reason: The article-editor Delete text is #e63757 on white at 13px normal and measures 4.15:1, below 4.5:1, on desktop and at 320 CSS pixels.
confirmedFindings.impact: Low-vision users have insufficient contrast on the destructive article control.

confirmedFindings.reason: After the note dialog settles, forward Tab visits Close, Add, BODY and the dialog; reverse traversal from Close repeatedly focuses the dialog container instead of wrapping to Add.
confirmedFindings.impact: Keyboard focus leaves the modal's visible controls, and reverse traversal cannot reach the last action by wrapping. Escape and focus restoration work. This is not asserted as a screen-reader failure.

confirmedFindings.reason: The branding summary focus outline rgba(113,62,224,.4) on white measures 1.90:1 after alpha compositing; the audit ignored alpha and reported 6.06:1.
confirmedFindings.impact: The focus outline misses the stated 3:1 non-text requirement, and the audit calculation conceals it.
